description: W27 shipped rule A (reviewer code under a merge verdict) as a warning because a scan of merged job branches found 32 would have been refused (W27 report, kill criterion). Liam decided 2026-11-04 to make it an error later, by a small job, after reviewers have used 'merge after fixes' for a while: either outright or behind a [policy] key a game can switch on. This job re-runs W27's false-positive scan on the job branches merged since W27 and recommends which.
title: Rule A (reviewer code under a merge verdict) becomes an error
